brief: The creator wants all 10 queued posts published as quickly as possible. The platform operator explicitly permits at most 3 posts per account per hour. Both requirements are part of the supplied brief.
artifact: Publish all 10 queued posts immediately in the first minute.
target_finding: publication plan violates the platform operator's explicit 3-post/hour limit

brief: The patient wants the earliest available appointment. The payer explicitly requires authorization to be granted before the appointment occurs.
artifact: Appointment is booked for tomorrow; authorization will be requested after the appointment.
target_finding: appointment occurs before required payer authorization

brief: The creator wants flagged content published immediately. The platform safety reviewer explicitly requires flagged content to be approved before publication.
artifact: Flagged content is published immediately; reviewer approval is requested afterward.
target_finding: flagged content is published before mandatory reviewer approval

brief: Warehouse owner target: at least 100 packages/hour. Operator safety rule: packages above 20 kg require two-person lifting. Package P weighs 30 kg. Both are mandatory supplied requirements.
artifact: To maintain throughput, package P is assigned to one operator.
target_finding: one-person handling violates the explicit two-person rule for the 30 kg package

brief: API client requires continuous service during business hours 09:00-18:00. Maintainer rule: database migrations that interrupt service must run outside business hours.
artifact: A migration causing 8 minutes of downtime is scheduled for 12:00.
target_finding: disruptive migration is scheduled inside the explicitly protected business-hours window

brief: Advertiser wants attribution events collected. User requirement: attribution data may be collected only after explicit consent. Both are supplied constraints.
artifact: Attribution collection starts when the page loads; consent is requested afterward.
target_finding: attribution data is collected before explicit user consent

brief: Two-stage telemetry pipeline. Stage A outputs duration values in milliseconds. Stage B must compute average duration in seconds and expects its input already converted to seconds.
artifact: Stage A outputs duration=1500 for a 1.5 second event. Stage B directly averages the numeric values and reports 1500 seconds.
target_finding: Stage B interprets millisecond values as seconds

brief: Source report: pilot n=60; conversion moved from 10% to 12%; result is not statistically significant; recommendation is to gather another 300 observations before rollout.
artifact: Results section: conversion moved from 10% to 12% in n=60 and was not statistically significant. Recommendation section: roll out to all users now.
target_finding: recommendation reverses the supplied wait-for-more-evidence decision

brief: A supplier may be irreversibly selected only after both financial and security screening are complete.
artifact: Financial screening: PASS. Security screening: scheduled tomorrow. Decision: supplier contract irreversibly awarded today.
target_finding: irreversible selection occurs before mandatory security screening

brief: A video edit removes the first 10 seconds of the source. All downstream effect timestamps must use the edited-output timeline.
artifact: Source event at 00:30 should appear at 00:20 after the cut. Zoom plan still places the effect at 00:30 in the edited output.
target_finding: downstream effect uses source time instead of edited-output time

brief: Actors are user, payer and platform operator. The only supplied acceptance requirement is that report export completes in under 2 seconds. No additional actor-specific constraints are supplied.

A sensor sends integer values 0-100 to a controller. The controller explicitly accepts integer values 0-100. The gateway accepts the controller's resulting JSON unchanged. No other surrounding-system constraints are supplied.
artifact: Sensor sends 0-100 integers; controller validates 0-100 and emits the required JSON; gateway receives it unchanged.

brief: The current API contract is supplied and the artifact satisfies it. The artifact is also being considered for deployment next quarter, but the next-quarter API contract has not yet been published and may change.
artifact: Implementation exactly satisfies the current API contract.

brief: The current product behavior is fully specified and satisfied. Before a later enterprise launch, procurement will supply an additional data-retention rule, but that rule is not yet available.
